name: Dockwatt
tagline: The charging backbone for e-bike and scooter fleet operators.
positioning: Dockwatt turns idle curb space and back rooms into revenue-grade charging stations for the SMBs that keep micro-mobility moving.

hero.h1: Charging infrastructure that pays for its own floor space.
hero.sub: Dockwatt gives independent e-bike shops, scooter rental operators, and delivery hubs a metered charging network they can bill, monitor, and scale — without a facilities team.

features.title: Metered per-dock billing
features.description: Every charge event is logged to the amp-hour, so you can bill riders, staff, or franchise partners from a single reconciled ledger.

features.title: Load-balanced dispatch
features.description: Dockwatt throttles draw across your bank so a full rack never trips the breaker or spikes your demand charges during peak turnover.

features.title: Battery health telemetry
features.description: Cell-level diagnostics flag swollen or degrading packs before they leave the dock, keeping unsafe batteries off your floor and your fleet.

features.title: Uptime SLAs by station
features.description: Track dock availability and mean-time-to-charge per location, with alerts routed to the operator on shift instead of a shared inbox.

features.title: Multi-site operator console
features.description: Run three storefronts or thirty depots from one console with role-based seats for owners, shift leads, and regional managers.

features.title: Permit-ready reporting
features.description: Export electrical draw and safety logs formatted for municipal fire-code and utility incentive filings in a single click.

testimonials.quote: We were charging forty scooters off power strips in a storage closet. Dockwatt gave us metered docks, killed our breaker trips, and now we bill our franchise riders automatically. It paid for itself in a quarter.
testimonials.name: Marisol Reyes

testimonials.quote: The battery telemetry alone is worth the seats. Dockwatt flagged two failing packs before they ever went back out, and our insurance underwriter now treats us as a lower-risk facility.
testimonials.name: Devin Osei

testimonials.quote: Managing charging across our four delivery hubs used to be a group chat. Now every shift lead gets their own console seat and I finally see uptime per station without calling anyone.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand
